description:
Vector Database Search Tools - Autonomous AI control over document search and retrieval

🎯 PURPOSE: Give AI agents the ability to search vector databases on-demand instead of automatic snippet injection.

💡 HOW IT WORKS:
1. AI decides when to search (not automatic)
2. AI crafts specific search queries
3. Results include metadata for full document retrieval
4. AI can fetch complete documents from cloud drives

⚡ WORKFLOW:
AI Query → vector_db_search → Get snippets + metadata → vector_db_get_full_document → Complete file

tools.name: vector_db_search
tools.short_description: Search vector database for document snippets - semantic similarity, metadata, cloud URLs
tools.description:
🔍 Search vector database for relevant document snippets.

🎯 USE THIS WHEN:
- User asks about specific topics/concepts
- Need context from uploaded documents
- Building answers from knowledge base
- Looking for specific information

⚠️ AI DECIDES WHEN TO SEARCH (not automatic!)

📊 RESULTS INCLUDE:
- Text snippets (400 chars each)
- Similarity scores (0-1, higher = more relevant)
- Document metadata (file name, type, location)
- Cloud storage links (Drive/OneDrive URLs)
- Full document retrieval IDs

💡 SMART USAGE:
- Craft specific queries for better results
- Use follow-up searches to refine
- Combine results from multiple searches
- Fetch full documents when snippets aren't enough

🔗 CHAIN WITH: vector_db_get_full_document to retrieve complete files

query.description: Search query text. Be specific for better results. Examples: 'product return policy', 'Q4 sales figures', 'patient consent forms', 'API authentication steps'

namespace.description: Vector database namespace/collection to search (default: 'default'). Use user-specific or workspace-specific namespaces for isolation.

top_k.description: Number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20). More results = broader context but more tokens.

min_score.description: Minimum similarity score threshold (0-1, default: 0.7). Higher = more relevant but fewer results. Recommended: 0.7-0.8 for precise matches, 0.5-0.6 for broader searches.

include_metadata.description: Include full document metadata (file path, size, created date, cloud URLs). Set to true for document retrieval workflow (default: true).

tools.name: vector_db_get_full_document
tools.short_description: Retrieve full document from Drive/OneDrive - complete text after vector search
tools.description:
📄 Retrieve complete document from cloud storage (Google Drive/OneDrive).

🎯 USE THIS WHEN:
- Snippets from vector_db_search aren't enough
- Need to see complete document structure
- User asks for full document
- Building comprehensive summaries

⚠️ WORKFLOW:
1. First call vector_db_search to get document_id
2. Then call this tool with document_id
3. Returns full text + metadata

💡 SMART USAGE:
- Check file size before retrieving (large PDFs may be slow)
- Use for documents under 10MB for best performance
- Combine with vector_db_search for targeted retrieval

🔗 INTEGRATES WITH: Google Drive, OneDrive, local storage

document_id.description: Document ID from vector_db_search results (e.g., 'doc_abc123'). This is the metadata.document_id field from search results.

namespace.description: Vector database namespace where document is stored (default: 'default'). Must match namespace used in vector_db_search.

format.description: Return format: 'text' (plain text), 'markdown' (formatted), 'json' (structured with metadata). Default: 'text'.

fetch_from_cloud.description: Fetch latest version from cloud storage (Google Drive/OneDrive) if available. Set to false to use cached vector database version (default: true).

tools.name: vector_db_list_namespaces
tools.short_description: List vector database namespaces - collections, document counts, statistics
tools.description:
📂 List all available vector database namespaces/collections.

🎯 USE THIS WHEN:
- Discovering available document collections
- Checking workspace/user document access
- Planning multi-namespace searches

💡 RETURNS:
- Namespace names
- Document counts
- Vector counts
- Last updated timestamps

tools.name: vector_db_get_document_metadata
tools.short_description: Get document metadata only - size, type, location without full text
tools.description:
📋 Get document metadata without fetching full text.

🎯 USE THIS WHEN:
- Need file info (size, type, location)
- Checking document availability
- Planning whether to fetch full document

💡 FAST & LIGHTWEIGHT:
- Returns only metadata (no text)
- Check file size before downloading
- Verify cloud storage links
